outcome: Insulin resistance (Homeostatic Model Assessment Insulin Resistance score (HOMA-IR))
cohort: The study included 113 pregnant women with chronic hepatitis B infection recruited from three tertiary maternity centres in Melbourne, Australia.
finding: QuantHBsAg was significantly lower in those with GDM, but no other associations were identified between GDM or HOMA-IR and markers of hepatic activity.
